name: connection-settings-help-phone
description: At a phone viewport the shared connection settings row stacks its label, control, and help in one column. The credential-header row always carries help; without a mobile reset of .settingHelp's grid-column: 2, the help creates an implicit second column and the input sits beside its label instead of under it.

mutation.declaration: panes/settings/sections/credentials/ConnectionFacts.module.css: the @media (max-width: 480px) .settingHelp { grid-column: 1 } reset (deleted), leaving grid-column: 2 in the one-column row
mutation.note: Red run before the mobile reset: the help keeps grid-column 2, the row grows an implicit second column, and the geometry assertions fail. Restoring the reset passes with the label, input, and help stacked in one column.
